# Background

We conducted this experiment to study the effect of *mmf1* mutants, and mutants affected in ETI signalling pathways on BX-growth feedbacks. We repeated screening of *mmf1* mutants three times

# Materials and methods

We grew Arabidopsis plants on BXplus and BXminus soils and phenotyped them for rosette area and weighed them at the end of the experiment. We extracted the phenotypes using ARADEEPOPSIS (@hüther2020).

**Experiments:**

-   ***mmf1*** **mutants**:

1- Screening of *mmf1-1* on BS04 soil batch

2- Screening of *mmf1-1* and *mmf1-2* BS04 soil batch

3- Screening of *mmf1-1* and *mmf1-2* BS09 soil batch

-   **ETI mutants**:

4- Screening of *pad4-1*, *eds1-12* and *sag101-3* on BS07 soil batch

5- Screening of *pad4-1*, *eds1-12* and *sag101-3* on BS07 soil batch

-   **Purpose**: We performed this study to confirm the involvement of MMF1 in BX-feedbacks.

# Important results

*mmf1* mutants had a significant effect on the growth of Arabidopsis plants on BXplus and BXminus soils. They showed no growth feedback. ETI mutants on the other hand showed a significant growth feedback on BXplus soils.

# Function to Add Replicate Number to Graph

```{r}
# Function to display the number of replicates below each bar
give.n <- function(x){
  return(c(y = median(x) * -0.005, label = length(x)))
}

# Function to make colored facets at the bottom
element_textbox_highlight <- function(..., 
                                      hi.labels = NULL, hi.fill = NULL,
                                      hi.col = NULL, hi.box.col = NULL,
                                      hi.labels2 = NULL, hi.fill2 = NULL,
                                      hi.col2 = NULL, hi.box.col2 = NULL) {
  structure(
    c(element_textbox(...),
      list(hi.labels = hi.labels, hi.fill = hi.fill, hi.col = hi.col, 
           hi.box.col = hi.box.col,
           hi.labels2 = hi.labels2, hi.fill2 = hi.fill2, hi.col2 = hi.col2, 
           hi.box.col2 = hi.box.col2)
    ),
    class = c("element_textbox_highlight", "element_textbox", "element_text", "element",
              "element_textbox_highlight", "element_textbox", "element_text", "element")
  )
}

element_grob.element_textbox_highlight <- function(element, label = "", ...) {
  if (label %in% element$hi.labels) {
    element$fill <- element$hi.fill %||% element$fill
    element$colour <- element$hi.col %||% element$colour
    element$box.colour <- element$hi.box.col %||% element$box.colour
  }
  if (label %in% element$hi.labels2) {
    element$fill <- element$hi.fill2 %||% element$fill
    element$colour <- element$hi.col2 %||% element$colour
    element$box.colour <- element$hi.box.col2 %||% element$box.colour
  }
  NextMethod()
}
# Purpose: Define functions for visualizing the number of replicates in a graph and customizing text box elements.
```

# Experiment III: Screening of *mmf1-1* on BS04 soil batch

## Modify and Verify Data

```{r}
# Change the levels of the 'line' column
weight_E1 <- weight_E1 %>%
  mutate(line = factor(line, levels = c("WT", "mmf1-1")))

#number of replicates
kable(
  table(weight_E1$BX, weight_E1$line), 
  caption = "Number of replicates (E-III)"
)
# Purpose: Relevel the 'line' factor and filter out rows with missing fresh weight data.
```

## Plot Fresh Weight

```{r}
#| label: fig-mmf1-mutants-Fw-EIII
#| fig-cap: "Feedbacks of mmf1 mutants in manuscript experiments (E-III)."
#| warning: false
# Generate the boxplot
fresh_weight_E1 <- weight_E1 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = line, y = fresh_weight, fill = BX)) + 
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), alpha = 0.6, 
               color = "grey35",
               outlier.colour = NA, size = 0.5) + 
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(dodge.width = 0.85, size = 1, shape = 21, 
                               color = "black",
                               width = 0.1, alpha = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", linewidth = 0.5, 
               width = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.85)) + 
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", paired = FALSE, size = 2, 
                     label.y = 0.09, label.x = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Conditioning", values = c("seagreen", "gold2")) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.10)) +
  ggtitle("E1 - Fresh Weight") +  # Add a title
  ylab("Fresh Weight") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("WT", expression(italic("mmf1-2")))) + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0),  # Move title to the left
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7),  # Facet strip text size
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Display the plot
print(fresh_weight_E1)
# Purpose: Generate and display a boxplot for fresh weight data in MMF1 mutants.
```

## Statistics

```{r}
# Perform ANOVA for MMF1 mutants
# Fit the ANOVA model for fresh weight
# Fit the ANOVA model
MMF1_anova_model_Fw_E1 <- aov(fresh_weight ~ line * BX, data = weight_E1)

# Extract the ANOVA table and format it with kable
anova_table <- summary(MMF1_anova_model_Fw_E1)[[1]]  # Extract the ANOVA table as a data frame

# Display the ANOVA table using kable
library(knitr)
kable(anova_table, caption = "ANOVA Table for Fresh Weight (E-III)")


# Fit the ANOVA model for plant region area
MMF1_anova_model_rosettearea_E1 <- aov(plant_region_area ~ line * BX, 
                                       data = phenotypes_E1)

# Extract the ANOVA table and format it with kable
anova_table <- summary(MMF1_anova_model_rosettearea_E1)[[1]]  # Extract the ANOVA table as a data frame

# Display the ANOVA table using kable
kable(anova_table, caption = "ANOVA Table for Plant Region Area (E-III)")
# Purpose: Perform ANOVA to analyze the effects of line and BX on fresh weight and plant region area in MMF1 mutants.
```

-   **Purpose**: We performed ANOVA to analyze the effects of line and BX on fresh weight and plant region area in MMF1 mutants.

### Perform ANOVA and FDR Correction for fresh weight

```{r}
# Perform ANOVA and FDR correction for fresh weight
stat.test_FW <- weight_E1 %>%
  group_by(line) %>%
  do({
    model <- aov(fresh_weight ~ BX, data = .)
    anova_results <- summary(model)[[1]]
    p_value <- anova_results[["Pr(>F)"]][1]
    data.frame(p_value = p_value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"),
    significance = cut(p.adj, 
                       breaks = c(0, 1e-04, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
                       labels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))
  )

# Display the result using kable
kable(stat.test_FW, caption = "Statistical Test Results for Fresh Weight (E-III)")
```

### **Perform ANOVA and FDR correction for Rosette area**

```{r}
stat.test_region_area <- phenotypes_E1 %>%
  group_by(line) %>%
  do({
    model <- aov(plant_region_area ~ BX, data = .)
    anova_results <- summary(model)[[1]]
    p_value <- anova_results[["Pr(>F)"]][1]
    data.frame(p_value = p_value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"),
    significance = cut(
      p.adj,
      breaks = c(0, 1e-04, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
      labels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns")
    )
  )

# Display the results using kable
library(knitr)
kable(stat.test_region_area, caption = "Statistical Test Results for Plant Region Area (E-III)")
```

```{r}
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"),
    significance = cut(p.adj, 
                       breaks = c(0, 1e-04, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
                       labels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))
  )

# Display the result using kable
```

```{r}
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3000000)) +
  ggtitle("E3 - Plant Area") +  # Add a title
  ylab("Plant Area") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("WT", expression(italic("mmf1-1")), 
                              expression(italic("mmf1-2")))) +  # Adjust x-axis labels
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0),  # Title aligned to the left
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),  # Optional: Remove x-axis title
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7),  # Facet strip text size
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Display the plot
print(plant_area_E3)
# Purpose: Generate and display a boxplot for plant area data in MMF1 mutants.
```

## Statistics

```{r, echo=FALSE,  message=FALSE}
# Perform ANOVA for MMF1 mutants
# Fit the ANOVA model for fresh weight
# Fit the ANOVA model
MMF1_anova_model_Fw_E3 <- aov(fresh_weight ~ genotype * soil, data = weight_E3)

# Extract the ANOVA table and format it with kable
anova_table <- summary(MMF1_anova_model_Fw_E3)[[1]]  # Extract the ANOVA table as a data frame

# Display the ANOVA table using kable
library(knitr)
kable(anova_table, caption = "ANOVA Table for Fresh Weight (E-V)")


# Fit the ANOVA model for plant region area
MMF1_anova_model_rosettearea_E3 <- aov(plant_region_area ~ genotype * soil, 
                                       data = phenotypes_E3)

# Extract the ANOVA table and format it with kable
anova_table <- summary(MMF1_anova_model_rosettearea_E3)[[1]]  # Extract the ANOVA table as a data frame

# Purpose: Perform ANOVA to analyze the effects of line and BX on fresh weight and plant region area in MMF1 mutants.
```

### Perform ANOVA and FDR Correction for fresh weight

```{r}
# Perform ANOVA and FDR correction for fresh weight
stat.test_FW <- weight_E3 %>%
  group_by(genotype) %>%
  do({
    model <- aov(fresh_weight ~ soil, data = .)
    anova_results <- summary(model)[[1]]
    p_value <- anova_results[["Pr(>F)"]][1]
    data.frame(p_value = p_value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"),
    significance = cut(p.adj, 
                       breaks = c(0, 1e-04, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
                       labels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))
  )

# Display the result using kable
kable(stat.test_FW, caption = "Statistical Test Results for Fresh Weight (E-V)")
```

```{r}
    p_value <- anova_results[["Pr(>F)"]][1]
```

## Plot Dry Weight for ETI Mutants

```{r, echo=FALSE,  message=FALSE, fig.height=5}
#| label: fig-ETI-mutants-Dw
#| fig-cap: "Feedbacks of ET mutantss (E-VI)."
#| warning: false
#| 
plant_weight_ETI_filter <- plant_weight_ETI %>%
  mutate(line = factor(line, levels = c("Col0", "eds1", "pad4", "sag101")))


# Generate the boxplot for dry weight
dry_weight_ETI <- plant_weight_ETI %>%
  mutate(line = factor(line, levels = c("Col0", "eds1", "pad4", "sag101"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = line, y = dry_weight, fill = BX)) + 
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), alpha = 0.6, 
               color = "grey35", outlier.colour = NA, size = 0.5) + 
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(dodge.width = 0.85, size = 1, shape = 21, 
                               color = "black", width = 0.1, alpha = 0.4, 
                               show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", linewidth = 0.5, 
               width = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.85)) + 
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", paired = FALSE, size = 2, 
                     label.y = 48, label.x = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Conditioning", values = c("seagreen", "gold2")) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 50)) +
  ggtitle("ETI - Dry Weight") +  # Add a title
  ylab("Dry Weight (mg)") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("WT", expression(italic("eds1-12")), 
                              expression(italic("pad4-1")), 
                              expression(italic("sag101-3")))) +  # Adjust x-axis labels
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0),  # Title aligned to the left
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7),  # Facet strip text size
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Display the plot
print(dry_weight_ETI)
# Purpose: Generate and display a boxplot for dry weight data in ETI mutants.
```

# Export data as Datasets

```{r}
# Load the openxlsx package
library(openxlsx)

# Create a new workbook
Dataset4 <- createWorkbook()

# Add sheets from mmf1 mutants and write data frames to them
addWorksheet(Dataset4, "ExpIII_mmf1_weight")
writeData(Dataset4, "ExpIII_mmf1_weight", weight_E1)
addWorksheet(Dataset4, "ExpIII_mmf1_phenotypes")
writeData(Dataset4, "ExpIII_mmf1_phenotypes", phenotypes_E1)

addWorksheet(Dataset4, "ExpIV_mmf1_weight")
writeData(Dataset4, "ExpIV_mmf1_weight", weight_E2)
addWorksheet(Dataset4, "ExpIV_mmf1_phenotypes")
writeData(Dataset4, "ExpIV_mmf1_phenotypes", phenotypes_E2)

addWorksheet(Dataset4, "ExpV_mmf1_weight")
writeData(Dataset4, "ExpV_mmf1_weight", weight_E3)
addWorksheet(Dataset4, "ExpV_mmf1_phenotypes")
writeData(Dataset4, "ExpV_mmf1_phenotypes", phenotypes_E3)


# Add sheets from ETI mutants and write data frames to them
addWorksheet(Dataset4, "ExpVI_ETI_weight")
writeData(Dataset4, "ExpVI_ETI_weight", plant_weight_ETI)
addWorksheet(Dataset4, "ExpVI_ETI_phenotypes")
writeData(Dataset4, "ExpVI_ETI_phenotypes", plant_region_area_ETI)



# Save the workbook to an Excel file
saveWorkbook(Dataset4, "Output/Tables/Dataset4.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

# Session information

**Purpose**: Print the session information, including details about the R version, loaded packages, and the system environment. This is useful for reproducibility, as it documents the computational environment in which the analysis was performed.

```{r}
# Get session information
SI <- sessionInfo()

# Extract the attached packages and their versions
attached_packages <- SI$otherPkgs

# Print the R version
cat("R version:", SI$R.version$version.string, "\n\n")

# Print the attached packages and their versions
cat("Attached packages:\n")
invisible(lapply(attached_packages, function(pkg) {
  cat(pkg$Package, "-", pkg$Version, "\n")
}))
```
